WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        home_team as team,
        season,
        SUM(home_team_goal) as total_goals
    FROM match_view
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY home_team, season
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        away_team as team,
        season,
        SUM(away_team_goal) as total_goals
    FROM match_view
    WHERE away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY away_team, season
),
team_highest_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        MAX(total_goals) as highest_season_goals
    FROM team_season_goals

),
ranked_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        highest_season_goals,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY highest_season_goals) as rn
    FROM team_highest_season_goals
)
SELECT AVG(highest_season_goals) as median
FROM ranked_goals

WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        m.season,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal ELSE 0 END +
              CASE WHEN m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal ELSE 0 END) as season_goals
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE m.home_team_api_id IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, m.season
),
team_max_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        team_long_name,
        MAX(season_goals) as highest_season_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id, team_long_name
),
ranked_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        team_long_name,
        highest_season_goals,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY highest_season_goals) as row_num
    FROM team_max_season_goals
)
SELECT 
    team_long_name,
    highest_season_goals
FROM ranked_goals
WHERE row_num = 150
